d: AI Engineer - SeniorFieldDetailsLocationAbu Dhabi and Dubai, UAEEngagement ModelFull-timeLanguageArabic, EnglishEmployment TypeOCSDuration6 months

AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and deployment of production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high-quality data. They own the technical architecture and quality of AI solutions end to end, turning complex use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation.

The role works alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council, and acts as the technical lead and mentor for junior AI engineers. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production at scale, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview-governed data foundation, and to set the engineering and responsible-AI standards the team follows.

Lead the end-to-end design, development and deployment of AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases, from use-case shaping through to production operations

Architect enterprise-scale retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking, agentic and prompt orchestration, and grounding on curated Gold-layer data, optimising for accuracy, latency and cost

Define and operationalise responsible-AI controls covering explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubai's AI ethics principles, and present them to the Data Governance Council

Design secure, scalable APIs and integration patterns that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access, data masking, private networking and identity controls enforced
Partner with data architects and data engineers to define AI-ready data products, feature pipelines and data-quality gates, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls
Establish the evaluation framework: accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, automated regression testing, red-teaming and go/no-go release criteria applied before each release
Own CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, drift detection, observability and cost management for AI workloads in production

Lead the application of UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including threat modelling, data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging, in coordination with security and data-protection teams

Act as technical lead for the AI workstream: lead and mentor junior AI engineers, run design and code reviews, set engineering standards and best practices, and support estimation, planning and delivery quality
Advise senior business and technology stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, roadmap and trade-offs, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions and delivery plans
Produce and review model cards, solution architecture and design decisions, runbooks and audit evidence for each AI component
Lead capability building for Client's counterparts in AI engineering practices, tooling and responsible-AI operations so that solutions can be sustained after handover
q: 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years designing, building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production, including ownership of multiple enterprise-scale deployments
Proven experience as a technical lead, guiding and mentoring a team of engineers and owning solution architecture and delivery quality
Expert-level Python skills, with deep experience in frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch, scikit-learn or Hugging Face, and in building agentic and multi-step LLM workflows
Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning and vector databases, including hybrid retrieval, evaluation and fine-tuning approaches
Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code
Strong command of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt engineering, red-teaming, observability and responsible-AI practices
Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview
Working knowledge of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR, with experience applying it in delivery
Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
Arabic proficiency and Arabic NLP experience
Relevant Microsoft Azure AI or architecture certifications (for example Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert)
Experience in government or other regulated sectors

Translate business requirements into practical HR strategies and interventions.

d: Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).
In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.
Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.
q: 5 years experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance organisation
Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes, cloud management, and IT automation (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)
Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely
Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
Good verbal and written communication skills in French
The Following Are Considered a Plus
Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization
Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering
Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role
Experience with training and presentation delivery

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
r: Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.

Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat

Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
